objectives.description: Write scripts/tests/test-issue-record.sh modeled on test-orchestrate-record-decision.sh: 15 cases covering schema validation, byte-identical refusal, concurrency, unknown-class warn-and-append, non-fatal failure form, win entries, --task N resolution (success and refusal), mutually-exclusive task args, cost-value/unit pairing, and full-field population
Register tests/test-issue-record.sh in manifest.json's scripts array
Run the suite (15/15 PASSED) and shellcheck (matches the identical SC2329-info-only baseline already accepted for test-orchestrate-record-decision.sh)

deviations.description: Scope Hypothesis estimated roughly 9-11 discrete cases
deviations.reason: 15 cases were written to cover additional edge conditions found useful during implementation (mutually-exclusive --task-dir/--task, cost-value/cost-unit pairing, invalid --severity, full-field population) beyond the four named coverage areas' minimum. More cases than the estimate is not a coverage gap per the phase's own Scope Hypothesis wording (only materially FEWER would indicate a collapsed area).
